project_type: Python CLI tool — shell script entry point backed by Python 3.11+, Strands Agents SDK, Ollama, and swappable RAG backends (FAISS default, Qdrant optional)
build_system: No build step. Install via pip: `pip install -r requirements.txt`. Entry point: `./myagent` shell script that execs `python -m agent.main`.
test_framework: No test framework currently in the repo. No automated tests are in scope for this task — manual smoke tests using the CLI verify each feature.
test_command: python -m agent.main --list-models (smoke test); python -c 'from agent.config import MODELS' (import test)
verification_instructions: 1. pip install -r requirements.txt. 2. python -c 'from agent.config import MODELS; from agent.tools import bash_exec; from agent.rag.faiss_rag import FAISSBackend'. 3. ./myagent --list-models. 4. If Ollama is running: ./myagent -m qwen and type a message.
snapshot_or_generated_files: .rag_index/faiss/ — created at runtime by FAISSBackend.ingest(). Not checked in.
environment_constraints: Ollama must be running on localhost:11434 for live tests. For import-only tests, Ollama is not needed. faiss-cpu requires a C-compatible environment (standard on Linux x86-64). sentence-transformers downloads all-MiniLM-L6-v2 on first use (~90MB from HuggingFace).
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md in this repo. Match Spanish language in system prompts and user-facing messages. Follow PEP 8. Pin all dependency versions in requirements.txt.
key_patterns: 1. Strands @tool decorator: `from strands import tool` then `@tool def my_tool(x: str) -> str: ...` — docstring becomes tool description for the LLM. 2. Strands Agent: `from strands import Agent; from strands.models.ollama import OllamaModel; agent = Agent(model=OllamaModel(host=..., model_id=...), tools=[...], system_prompt=...)`. 3. Spanish system prompt pattern from legacy/agentsvc/main.py SYSTEM_PROMPT. 4. SHA-256 manifest for incremental ingest from legacy/ragapi/ingest.py (sha256_file, load_manifest, save_manifest). 5. Qdrant query engine from legacy/ragapi/main.py build_engine(). 6. LlamaIndex ingest pipeline from legacy/ragapi/ingest.py main().
directory_structure: repo root: myagent (shell script), requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, .env.example, docker-compose.yml, README.md. agent/: Python package with config.py, main.py, tools.py, rag/ subpackage. scripts/: install.sh, pull-models.sh. legacy/: renamed from model-rag-local/, contains the original Docker-based RAG system.
